mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_chunks ( group_id, document_id, chunk_number, chunk_text, metadata_json, start_position, end_position, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{documentId}, #{chunkNumber}, #{chunkText}, cast(#{metadataJson} as jsonb), #{startPosition}, #{endPosition}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, document_id, chunk_number, chunk_text, metadata_json, start_position, end_position, created_at, updated_at FROM document_chunks WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY chunk_number ASC, id ASC
